title: Hospital operations and pharmacy utilisation review
audience: Hospital COO, pharmacy head and finance partner
question: How did operational activity, length of stay, supplied readmission flags and medication-order mix vary across departments during the six-month synthetic reporting period?
deliverables: SQL analysis with explicit grain and join strategy
Three-page dashboard or equivalent static report
Executive summary with actions, caveats and next steps
critical_cautions: A supplied readmission flag is not a validated readmission measure unless cohort logic and follow-up are defined.
Medication orders are not proof of administration, dispensing or adherence.
36 orphan order rows must be reviewed; do not silently drop them.
Do not join encounter-level and order-line tables before aggregating if it causes fan-out.

title: Clinical research and pharmacovigilance review
audience: Clinical research manager and drug safety lead
question: Can the synthetic trial summary and separate safety case extract be analysed transparently, with appropriate data controls and non-causal interpretation?
deliverables: Trial data dictionary, edit checks and query log
Descriptive trial summary and uncertainty-aware analysis plan
ICSR case/event data model and duplicate review workflow
Safety and clinical research handoff report
critical_cautions: Synthetic trial arms are not real randomised evidence.
Spontaneous-report counts do not provide incidence without exposure denominators.
Disproportionality is a screening method, not causality.
No licensed MedDRA content or validated regulatory reporting output is included.

title: Remote analytics client request-to-handoff
audience: Remote healthcare analytics client and delivery manager
question: A client requests an urgent department performance report and pharmacy utilisation extract. Deliver a reliable, traceable result asynchronously.
deliverables: Clarification questions and written scope confirmation
Data inventory, access/privacy check and delivery plan
SQL/Python outputs, QA log and reproducibility instructions
Versioned deliverable folder and concise client email
Change log, assumptions, exclusions and handoff checklist
critical_cautions: Never use identifiable patient data in a personal portfolio.
Do not infer clinical meaning from undocumented fields.
Escalate missing definitions, ambiguous denominators and access issues before publishing.
